name: green-slime-class-bonus-on-leave-transfer-buff
notes:
Green Slime (zgcxyky280, ALLY): "[Class Bonus] On Leave: Put the buff counters that were on Green Slime on target ally you control." ENGINE BUG (found, not fixed): this fixture documents the ability CURRENTLY silently failing to transfer its buff counters, even with Class Bonus active and buff counters present on Green Slime at the moment it leaves the field.

CORRECTION (verified independently after this fixture was first committed, via live error_log instrumentation of the actual closure and ExecuteStaticMethods() rather than a standalone reproduction): the ability's OWN mzID resolves correctly, and the originally-recorded root-cause theory below this paragraph is WRONG -- FireLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility's lack of an explicit mzID restore (unlike FireEnterTriggeredAbility's) is NOT the actual defect, because OpportunityLogic.php's shared EffectStackOpportunity handler (~line 1590-1598) already restores every key from the queued trigger's captured context -- including 'mzID' -- generically for ALL trigger types (ENTER, LEAVE_FIELD, etc.) before dispatching to the type-specific Fire*TriggeredAbility call. Live-traced confirmation: $mzID resolved to 'myField-1' (Green Slime itself, correct), $obj was found (not null), buffCount read 3 (correct), and the closure proceeded all the way through to successfully computing targets=['myField-2'] (Red Slime) and calling DecisionQueueController::AddDecision() for both the MZCHOOSE and the paired CUSTOM 'GreenSlimeTransfer' follow-up -- all of that genuinely executes.

The REAL defect, confirmed the same way (plus reading MZCountChoices()'s own doc comment in Core/DecisionQueueController.php ~line 296-298, which explicitly acknowledges this exact failure mode): Green Slime's closure computes its transfer-target mzID ('myField-2') WHILE Green Slime itself still occupies myField-1 (the departing object is deliberately kept readable at its old slot during LEAVE_FIELD resolution, per the docblock above QueueLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility). But by the time the queued MZCHOOSE decision is actually VALIDATED -- later in the SAME ExecuteStaticMethods() pass, after the caller that invoked OnLeaveField() goes on to perform Green Slime's real MZMove()-to-graveyard -- Green Slime has been spliced out of myField, shifting Red Slime down from index 2 to index 1. The captured string 'myField-2' is now stale: MZCountChoices('myField-2') resolves against the CURRENT (post-shift) field and finds nothing there, counts 0 valid choices, and ExecuteStaticMethods() auto-PASSes the MZCHOOSE (Core/DecisionQueueController.php ~line 152-155) instead of presenting it to the player. The paired CUSTOM 'GreenSlimeTransfer' decision then gets skipped outright because its own case explicitly short-circuits on lastDecision==="PASS" (~line 131), so AddCounters() is never even reached -- confirmed live: added temporary error_log tracing inside customDQHandlers['GreenSlimeTransfer'] itself and it never fires at all, even though the MZCHOOSE was genuinely queued with a then-valid target one statement earlier. This is a stale-mzID-after-index-shift bug, not a missing-ambient-variable-restore bug, and it would affect any On-Leave ability that captures ANOTHER on-field object's positional mzID before its own object is spliced out of the same zone array.

Original (incorrect) theory, kept here for context since it was the first-pass hypothesis before the correction above: QueueLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility() (Custom/GameLogic.php ~7797) captures the departing object's mzID into the queued trigger's OWN context (NormalizeMzIDForController($mzID, $controller)), deferring actual resolution (QueueTriggeredAbility -> EffectStack -> OpportunityLogic.php's 'LEAVE_FIELD' branch ~1640, which calls FireLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility($cardOwner, $cardID)). The original theory claimed FireLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility (~7808) never restores that captured mzID into the ambient 'mzID' variable before invoking the ability, unlike FireEnterTriggeredAbility's explicit restore -- this is DISPROVEN by the live trace above; the generic restore in OpportunityLogic.php's EffectStackOpportunity handler already covers it for every trigger type.

This fixture pins the CURRENT (buggy) behavior as a regression baseline so a future fix to the stale-target-mzID problem is easy to spot -- the assertions below (Red Slime's Counters staying '[]') will need updating once that bug is fixed.

Green Slime's own semantic-coverage requirement is already satisfied by the separate, UNAFFECTED Enter-trigger fixture green-slime-on-enter-two-buff-counters; this fixture exists purely to document the Leave-trigger bug for later triage, not to provide Green Slime's primary coverage.

Setup notes: champion CardID patched to Silvie, With the Pack (TAMER, base level 2) for the Class Bonus precondition, with Spirit of Fire (LMyKyVC2O9) layered into Subcards purely to keep FIRE enabled (confirmed live: without this, CanPlayerUseCardElement rejects Excoriate with flash message 'Element not enabled: FIRE') -- same 'CardID for class, Subcards for element' layering used in freezing-hail-blue-slime-class-bonus-buff. Green Slime is seeded directly onto the field with 3 buff counters pre-set (its Enter trigger is proven separately, so this is supporting setup for the DIFFERENT Leave trigger under test here, not a silent-fake-pass violation). The actual leave event is real: Excoriate (ls6g7xgwve, FIRE, reserve 4, 'Destroy target ally with reserve cost 4 or less', discounted to 3 by Silvie's base level 2) is played for real from hand and targets Green Slime, genuinely destroying it and dispatching leaveFieldAbilities.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Leave: Put the buff counters that were on Green Slime on target ally you control.

engineBug.summary: Verified via live error_log instrumentation (not just a standalone reproduction): a leaveFieldAbilities closure that computes another on-field object's positional mzID (e.g. Green Slime's buff-transfer target) captures it while the departing object still occupies its old slot. By the time the resulting MZCHOOSE decision is validated, the departing object has been spliced out of the zone, shifting later indices down -- the captured mzID string is now stale. MZCountChoices() (Core/DecisionQueueController.php, which itself documents this exact failure mode) resolves 0 valid choices against the shifted field and auto-PASSes the MZCHOOSE, which causes the paired CUSTOM follow-up handler to be skipped entirely (ExecuteStaticMethods' CUSTOM case short-circuits on lastDecision==="PASS"). An earlier version of this note incorrectly attributed this to FireLeaveFieldTriggeredAbility missing an explicit mzID restore (unlike FireEnterTriggeredAbility) -- that theory is disproven: OpportunityLogic.php's shared EffectStackOpportunity handler already restores the ambient mzID generically for every trigger type, confirmed live (the closure's OWN mzID resolves correctly throughout). The real defect is the stale TARGET mzID after the index shift, not a missing restore of the ability's own mzID.
engineBug.affectedFunction: MZCHOOSE target resolution after a zone-index shift (Core/DecisionQueueController.php's MZCountChoices/ExecuteStaticMethods), triggered via any leaveFieldAbilities closure that captures another object's positional mzID before its own object is spliced out of the same zone (e.g. zgcxyky280:0 in GrandArchiveSim/GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php)
